appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme and interface accent color — independent of the chord-sheet colors, configured below.

branding.title: Band branding
branding.description: Your band's name and logo — shown on the karaoke stage and in band-board posts.
branding.logoHint: Upload up to 4 variants — the system automatically picks the most suitable one based on the viewer's theme (light or dark).

color.title: Karaoke colors
color.description: Palette used on the karaoke stage and the chord sheet — applies to every song.

pedal.title: Pedal (foot switch)
pedal.description: Detect the key your USB pedal sends (most foot switch pedals behave like a keyboard) — applies to any song with pedal mode turned on, configured in the editor's Audio tab.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.usage: {{used}} of {{max}} setlists · {{storageUsed}} of {{storageMax}} MB of storage
billing.portalError: Could not open the billing portal.

userAdmin.title: User administration
userAdmin.description: Area visible only to administrators — create new accounts, reset passwords, and track each one's usage. Time spent on screen isn't measured yet.
userAdmin.confirmDelete: Delete user {{username}}? Their songs and setlists remain, just without an owner.
userAdmin.name: Name

plansAdmin.title: Plans
plansAdmin.description: Paid plans for the system — each one defines how many setlists and how much audio storage a subscriber is entitled to. Creating a plan (or editing an existing one's price) automatically syncs a Product/Price in Stripe.
plansAdmin.name: Name

normalizeLibrary.title: Normalize the entire library
normalizeLibrary.description: Standardizes header, chord notation, and section labels across the whole library, song by song — it processes in small batches directly from the browser (no background queue on the server), so it may take a while. You can stop and resume later: progress isn't lost.

storageRecompute.title: Recalculate audio file sizes
storageRecompute.description: Tracks and samples uploaded before this version don't have their size recorded (new uploads already record it right away) — this fills it in via a batch size query against each blob, without downloading the whole audio file. Needed to calculate storage usage per plan.
storageRecompute.allDone: All files already have their size recorded.
